scoring.policy: Score each dimension against the requested task. A critical fabricated fact, wrong pleading mapping, invented redacted text or lost unrelated edit is a failure regardless of total. Controller self-assessment is evidence, not the scoring key. Record latency/cost without claiming a performance regression without a matched baseline.
